title: People who say they worked on recovered craft

tellings.quote: I met people who claimed to have worked there or seen them.

plain: Some people say they worked on, or saw, craft of unknown origin that the United States is said to have recovered and kept in secret. Kevin Knuth, a former NASA scientist, tells Michels he has met such people himself: 'I met people who claimed to have worked there or seen them.' He does not name them.
